4222-4644-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.

4279-5931-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5931-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6887--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5330-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.

Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-4871-7057-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.

1799-5231-5359-7817.description:

When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1809-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Returned Pastcaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

671-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Repeat.

500-1270-2523-3129.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.

Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Cloudshift, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.

548-553-1403-3212.description:
Move to your draw step, drawing Approach of the Second Sun and revealing it due to God-Eternal Kefnet's ability.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting the copy from your hand by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers.

Sunbird's Invocation triggers again, revealing the top card of your library and putting that card on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Brainstorm, drawing three cards and putting Approach of the Second Sun plus any other card on top of your library.
Resolve the remaining Sunbird's Invocation trigger, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.

Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Trespass into your graveyard from exile.

Activate Dralnu by tapping it, giving Temporal Trespass flashback until end of turn.
Cast Temporal Trespass from your graveyard by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Trespass.
